name: Stormshell Parka
description: Een jas waar regen vanaf rolt.
wash: Machine wash 30°C. The finish wears off with washing and wear.
afterwards: PFAS from the finish do not break down naturally. They stay in water and soil long after the jacket is gone.

name: Trail Sneaker
wash: Wipe clean only. Do not machine wash.
afterwards: Wear, scuffing and cleaning can release residues of the coating into dust and rinse water.

name: Stainguard Chino
description: Een broek waar koffie vanaf rolt.
wash: Machine wash 40°C. Each wash can send part of the finish down the drain.
afterwards: Wastewater treatment plants are not built to filter out PFAS, so they end up in rivers and the sea.

name: Drizzle Bucket Hat
afterwards: Small item, same chemistry as the parka. The finish is what makes it last, and what makes it stay.
